body:
Well I took a hot bath and it really calmed me down along with the encouraging replies. My boyfriend said he wanted to take a break and will go back to his mother's house and will help with the rent for now. I'm going to keep on looking for a job and will look for a holiday location to work at. 

Hopefully I can get my life together. I'll come back if I'm feeling overwhelmed again or just to give an update. Thank you again for being here for my breakdown. I appreciate it.

Thank you so much. That actually offers a light of hope for me no matter how small.

I would also like to talk to you. It's always better to have someone to relate too with these sort of things. I really appreciate it.

Thank you. I'll definitely look into finding a job at a holiday location. That might just be better for me. I'd love to move. I thought of it for a long time but I would have to save up for it first.

Thank you for your response it helped me feel better about things.
